exposure: presentation of the fetus at term (vertex/breech)
cohort: 45 healthy pregnant women enrolled at 20th weeks of gestation and followed until term.
finding: Estimated fetal weight at term, fetal presentation, and actual birth weight were significant predictors of the change in cardiac axis, with each 100g increase in actual birth weight associated with a 0.375-degree increase in cardiac axis.
followup_time: from 20th gestational week to term (approximately 17-20 weeks)
birth_weight: Actual birth weight was measured, but no specific range or mean for the cohort is provided.
